description:
The Huffy ZRX 12" Kids Bike brings bold BMX-inspired style to young riders learning to ride. With a durable steel frame and motocross-style design, this bike is ready for driveway adventures and neighborhood rides while kids build confidence on two wheels.
The ZRX features Huffy’s EZ Build system, designed to make bike assembly faster and simpler. With a streamlined setup process and fewer steps, parents can get the bike ready quickly so young riders can spend more time enjoying the ride.
Training wheels provide extra stability while riders learn balance and steering. A coaster brake allows easy pedal-back stopping, while the front sidepull caliper brake adds responsive hand-brake control as skills grow. BMX-style front pegs and a crossbar pad complete the freestyle look for added style on every ride.

components.description: Dual Brake System: Coaster brake for simple pedal-back stopping plus a front sidepull caliper brake for added control as riding skills grow.
